newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's SEPI may approve Repsol stake sale soon.
newsitem.headline: Spain's SEPI may approve Repsol stake sale soon.

text.p: The board of Spanish state holding group SEPI could approve the sale of the state's 10 percent stake in energy group Repsol at the end of the month or early in February, a SEPI spokesman told Reuters.

"It is probable that SEPI, the entity that owns the 10 percent, will authorise the operation at the end of the month or at the beginning of February," he said, adding that this was one of the first steps to selling the government's remaining stake.
After SEPI's board authorises the sale, the cabinet's privatisation advisors must approve it. Then the cabinet must approve the sale.
On December 27, SEPI selected BBV Interactivos, Banco Santander Investment and Goldman Sachs as coordinators for the sale.
At the time, SEPI said it expected the Repsol sale to begin once Telefonica's was finished.
